evidence.subject: Mathematics
evidence.visualReview: The preserved UPSC PDF identifies NDA & NA Examination I 2026, provisional key, Paper I Mathematics, Series A, 120 questions, zero dropped and 120 scored. Series A was read column-first and row-first; both transcriptions agree.

searchLog.result: Current official answer-key route checked; no later final or revised Mathematics key was recovered during this release pass.
Official examination page confirms the 12 April 2026 examination and preserved Mathematics question paper; the provisional-key link is no longer exposed on that legacy page.
Preserved mirror of the UPSC provisional-key scan visually identifies NDA & NA Examination (I) 2026, Paper I Mathematics, Series A, 120 scored and zero dropped.

signoff.reviewerMethod: Claude transcript completeness review plus direct visual resolution of Q10 against the supplied Series A scan; figures for Q119-Q120 and the Series A provisional-key grid were visually checked by Codex.
signoff.classificationMethod: Question-by-question concept pass against the existing NDA Mathematics syllabus, followed by a fresh placement reread by the same AI agent.

formulaOrContentDefectsResolved.resolution: Verified the superscript in the second combination as n directly against PDF page 5.
